About the Project

A full-featured web application for managing a medical practice, built with Laravel and a centralized PostgreSQL database. It consolidates all clinic workflows in one place: patient records, appointments, consultations, prescriptions and billing.

A mobile application is currently under development, allowing doctors to access patient files and their schedule on the go — connecting to the same centralized database.

Key Features

Patient Management

Full medical records, consultation history and patient background.

Appointments & Scheduling

Booking, confirmation and automatic appointment reminders.

Consultations

Diagnoses entry, prescriptions and consultation notes per visit.

Prescriptions & Billing

PDF generation for prescriptions and patient invoices.

Centralized Database

Shared PostgreSQL between the web app and the upcoming mobile app.

Roles & Permissions

Differentiated access: doctor, secretary, administrator.

Tech Stack

Laravel PostgreSQL Blade Templates Tailwind CSS Alpine.js Laravel Auth Eloquent ORM RESTful API

Architecture

  • Laravel MVC — clean separation of concerns
  • Centralized & shared PostgreSQL database
  • REST API ready for the upcoming mobile app
  • Multi-role authentication (Policies & Gates)
  • PDF generation via DomPDF (prescriptions)
